By way of filing this writ petition, the petitioner has made the foll  prayer;
 (i) For a direction upon the respondent authori for re-measurement of the Acquired Building of the petitioner situated in village Palu, Khata No. 33,
Plot No. 823, P.S. Ormanjhi, Ranchi, build up area approximately 39 sq. metre, which was acquired under Bharatmala Project, but the Addl. District Land Acquisition Officer-cum-Circle Officer,
Ormanjhi by mistake has prepared the award under Section 23 and Section 30 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and resettlement Act, 2013 in the name of petitioner only for building of 28.98 sq. metre only.
(ii) In alternative, for direction upon the Addl. District Land Acquisition Officer-cum-Circle Officer,
Ormanjhi to refer the matter to the learned Arbitrator as per provision as mentioned in Section 3(G)(5) of National Highways Act, 1956.

3. Considering the aforesaid submission, I direct the petitioner to approach the Addl. Collector under Section 3(G) (5) of the National Highways Authority Act ventilating his grievance.
4. With the aforesaid observation and direction, this petition stands disposed of.
